run_benchplot_cli: run the benchplot CLI tool to generate a gnuplot PNG from an re2 benchlog file
parse_re2_benchlog: parse an re2 benchlog file into a dictionary grouped by benchmark category
gen_csv_tempfiles: generate temporary semicolon-delimited CSV files from parsed benchlog data for gnuplot consumption
run_gnuplot_plot: run gnuplot via subprocess to render a PNG chart from benchlog CSV data
review_gnuplot_class: review the gnuplot class context manager that cleans up temporary files on exit
